args.question: okay so it's near the end, only 10 empty squares left, I'm Black with way fewer discs right now. My legal moves are g2, b6, a7, b7, b8, c8. Which one actually sets me up best for the endgame count, not just the flip I get right now?

parts.content:
**b7** is the best setup move.

The key feature is the **bottom-left corner area**: playing **b7** controls that region without immediately handing White a clean corner grab, and it helps limit White’s replies. The other legal moves tend to let White stabilize an edge/corner sequence or leave Black with fewer good endgame moves.

args.question: okay so looking back, I was so unsure at that a1 vs g2 fork near the end — I ended up going a1 then h1 then g2 got auto-played. Was that actually the optimal order, or did I get lucky with White having no moves?

parts.content:
Yes — **a1 first was the right order**, not just luck.

The deciding feature was **corner-before-adjacent-square plus mobility**: **g2 sits next to the h1 corner**, so playing **a1** first secured a permanent corner and apparently left White with no useful reply/pass, letting you take **h1** before **g2** became safe. That “auto-play” happens when White has **no legal move**, so you earned the tempo by cutting off their mobility. Final result here is **Black 41–23**.

args.question: one more thing bugging me — earlier when I played b7 then c8, I actually lost a ton of discs to White (dropped to like 22 at one point) before it turned around. Was that dip just unavoidable, or did I mess up somewhere in that stretch?

parts.content:
That dip was **not automatically a mistake** — in endgames, disc count can swing wildly because many flipped discs are still unstable.  

The deciding feature was **corner tempo/mobility**: your **b7 → c8** line seems to have let White win temporary flips, but it preserved the sequence where you got **a1, h1, then g2**, and those corner-based discs became permanent. So dropping to ~22 was scary-looking but likely part of the winning route, not proof you messed up. Final board confirms the payoff: **Black 41–23**.

That actually makes total sense — like taking a rough beat in the middle of a scene before the payoff lands at the end. Good to know the dip wasn't me flubbing it, just part of setting up the corners. Really glad I checked in on both of those, feels good ending 41-23 knowing the choices actually held up. Good game!
